map.→ 打开债券定价计算器工具: -> Open the bond pricing calculator tool
map.为什么价格低于面值？: Why is the price below the face value?
map.债券定价计算器。输入面值、票息率、到期收益率与期限，按现金流折现求债券价格，用于: Bond pricing calculator. Enter the face value, coupon rate, yield to maturity and term, and the price is obtained by discounting the cash flows, for fixed income valuation and trading reference.
map.填写「年付息次数」。: Fill in "the number of coupon payments per year".
map.填写「年限 n」。: Fill in "the number of years n".
map.已知市场要求的到期收益率，反推债券的合理成交价。: Given the market-required yield to maturity, back out a fair transaction price for the bond.
map.市场收益率 6% 高于票息率 5%，旧债需折价才有人买；溢价/折价由 YTM 与: With the market yield at 6% above the 5% coupon, old bonds need a discount to attract buyers; the premium or discount is determined by the gap between the YTM and the coupon.
map.按到期收益率折现票息与面值。: Discount the coupons and the face value at the yield to maturity.
map.由年息、面值、价格与剩余年限求近似 YTM: Approximate YTM from annual interest, face value, price and remaining years
map.由每股股利与每股收益求股利支付率: Dividend payout ratio from dividend per share and earnings per share
map.看收益率上升时价格怎么跌（利率风险）。: See how the price falls when the yield rises (interest rate risk).
map.票息率>YTM 溢价（价格高于面值），相等则平价，小于则折价。上例票息 5%<Y: Coupon rate > YTM means a premium (price above face value); equal means at par; below means a discount. In the example above the coupon 5% < YTM 6%, so the theoretical price 957.35 CNY is below the 1000 CNY face value. Setting freq to 1 (annual coupons) gives about 957.88 CNY, so the coupon frequency also affects pricing.
map.票息率和 YTM 的关系如何决定价格？: How does the relation between the coupon rate and the YTM determine the price?
map.累计折现现金流回正年限: Years until the cumulative discounted cash flow turns positive
map.给定票息、到期收益率、期限，算债券合理价格。: Given the coupon, yield to maturity and term, compute a fair bond price.
map.股息率 = 年股息 / 股价: Dividend yield = annual dividend / share price
map.面值 1000、票息率 5%、YTM 6%、期限 5 年（半年付息）: Face value 1000, coupon rate 5%, YTM 6%, term 5 years (semi-annual coupons)
map.：P = 50×ä₁₀@6%(≈7.360) + 1000×v¹⁰(0.558): : P = 50xä10@6% (≈7.360) + 1000xv10 (0.558) = 368 + 558 = 926 CNY. Since the YTM is above the coupon it trades at a discount.
map.：页面默认 freq=2 即每年付息两次：每期票息 c=1000×5%/2=25: : the page defaults to freq=2, that is two coupon payments a year: the coupon per period c=1000x5%/2=25 CNY, the discount per period y=6%/2=3%, for T=5x2=10 periods. P=Σ25/(1.03)^t (t=1...10)+1000/(1.03)^10≈957.35 CNY. Since the coupon rate is below the YTM it is issued at a discount.
